failure_rule: Preserve failed metadata/result. Do not widen tags, change horizon, replace parents or automatically activate Click fallback.
next_phase_gate: The exact metadata result and its three-parent allowlist must be committed before a separately sealed parent-only collector can read those parents. Neither this protocol nor its output authorizes child source access.

resource_budget.AI_packet_limit_policy: Preflight complete-module packet size with a pinned tokenizer; at most64k input and8k output tokens per context. If a packet exceeds this budget, stop before reviewers; do not truncate a source module or replace its claims.
resource_budget.ceiling_policy: A resource stop preserves partial artifacts and failure status. It does not license dropping cases or silently shortening the registered horizon.

review_mode: two_fresh_AI_plus_reference; six fresh parent reviewer contexts,12 controls; packet seal before any review/reference decisions
source_access: Only repository/ref and commit identity/ordered parent/timestamp metadata. No source files, file lists, trees, blobs, diffs or commit subjects. A no-checkout blob-filtered clone is allowed; its contents must not be inspected.

source_configuration.parser: Pinned CPython3.12; disclose shared ast infrastructure. Source is never imported or executed.
source_configuration.rules: No automatic root expansion or file-limit change. Unsupported modes, encodings, syntax or binding hazards are reported. Feasibility and exclusions are recorded before child access.

token_budget_definition: Pinned tiktoken0.12.0 o200k_base measures the sealed research envelope (research system/task text, complete sources, cases, rubric and schema) as an explicit packet-size estimate. It does not count provider/harness/tool metadata or establish actual GPT6 context, reasoning-token or billing limits. No source truncation. Each returned primary review JSON is checked against the named8k output estimate before acceptance.
